LanguageData.Stargate.DisplayStudyReportDesc: Open the completed study report for the ancient Stargate.
LanguageData.Stargate.StudyReportObservation:
- Observations:
 1. It consists of several rings measuring 3.14 meters in diameter.
 2. It is made from an unknown exotic material by an ancient civilization.
 3. Rotating the inner ring creates a stable one-way wormhole to another ring.

- Conclusions:
 1. We will call this structure a Stargate.
 2. Missing components limit the artifact to receiving transfers.

- Recommendations:
 1. Exercise extreme caution around the artifact.
 2. Further study may permit interdimensional travel.
 3. Its exceptionally strong material may also be useful.
